# `mise history paths include`

- **Usage:** `mise history paths include <GLOB>`
- **Effect:** modifies state
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/history/paths/include.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/history/paths/include.rs)

Capture paths matching a glob again (removes it from `[history] exclude`)

## Arguments
